## Cost analysis

_Why is the current cost what it is? What ops dominate? Are there cheaper expressions of the same rule? Link a session log if you've measured._

2026-05-23 best structural path:
- Start from robust f16/crop lineage, then reorder to avoid full 30x30 F16 tensors: crop/cast/output dtype changes first reached 77753, then UINT8 output reached 71273.
- Converting the cropped one-hot logic to BOOL/UINT8 and reusing presence casts cut the frontend: direct full-input BOOL cast + channel/spatial slices, variadic `Max` for active foreground, and no redundant `safe_name_43` cast.
- Bbox finder now reduces row/col presence before `Where` min/max, so the expensive 18x18 F16 min/max masks became 18x1 or 1x18 skinny tensors.
- Color dilation uses `Cast(BOOL->UINT8) -> MaxPool(3x3) -> Greater` instead of F16 `Conv -> Greater`.
- Other-color masks use `Xor(active_foreground, color_mask)` because each color mask is a subset of active foreground; this removes eight full-size `Not` tensors.
- Final foreground occupancy uses variadic UINT8 `Max` over the already-cast output channels instead of an 8-deep BOOL `Or` chain.
- Remaining dominant costs are the full `[1,10,30,30]` BOOL input cast (9000 bytes), final `[1,10,18,18]` UINT8 concat (3240 bytes), and unavoidable per-color 18x18 masks/dilation plumbing.

2026-05-23 radical color-grid path:
- Rule derived from live: four colored rectangle-corner markers; preserve marker centers, stamp each 3x3 perimeter with opposite diagonal color, and draw color-5 dashed connectors with the live midpoint inequalities.
- The best verified model avoids paired one-hot foreground/background writes. It paints a compact uint8 color-index canvas, using visible-grid sentinel 10 outside the ARC rectangle, then returns final BOOL one-hot via `Equal(color_grid, [0..9])`.
- `ScatterElements` with INT32 flat indices is the main win: 52 color-cell writes replace the 96 scalar `ScatterND` color/ch0 writes. Earlier exact scatter milestones were 13,873, 10,803, 9,535, 8,924, 8,054, 7,085, 6,549, then 6,547.
- Current sub-5k/sub-3k blocker: full-tensor live equivalence requires preserving padding outside the variable input rectangle. The color-grid representation still materializes four 900-byte tensors (`color_base_4d`, `color_base_flat`, `color_flat`, `color_grid`/2D equivalent) plus bbox/color plumbing. Dropping the visible sentinel path fails full-tensor equality on padding.

Unscoreable (score_v2 None). Fixing via `value_info` re-charges the tensor's dense bytes into memory. General: sparse-init param trick is dead wherever the sparse tensor feeds a shape-sensitive op.
- 2026-07-03 | (2607 free-output render) **move any dense-init constant into a computed/materialized tensor** (drop-P widen-basis, coord2 via Mul, etc.) | rejected: params counts ELEMENTS (dtype-free), memory counts BYTES (dtype-weighted). An F16 constant of N elems costs N params as a dense init but 2N memory-bytes if materialized. Dense initializer is always the cheapest home for a constant. Measured: no-P = 3135 (+528).
